name: zkagent attestations
author: MCPVOT
description: The last zkagent verification verdict in the Omarchy bar: green when the newest receipt was accepted, red with the reason code when it was not, grey when the verdict is stale.

barWidget.description: Reads the verdict document written by `zkagent verify --json` and shows it. Click to re-verify the last bundle.

schema.label: Verdict file
schema.description: JSON written by `zkagent verify --json`. Absent file means no verdict yet, not a failure.

schema.label: Treat the verdict as stale after (seconds)
schema.description: An old verdict shows as a grey circle, not a green check: a stale green check is the failure mode this widget exists to avoid.

schema.label: Verification command
schema.description: Optional. Run on click; it should rewrite the verdict file, e.g. `zkagent verify-bundle --manifest attestation.json --blocks blocks/ --now $(date +%s) --json > ~/.local/state/zkagent/last-verdict.json`.
